units.source_text: 皇上看了《长恨歌》画册，觉得画中杨贵妃的容貌，虽然出于名画家之手，但笔力有限，到底缺乏生趣。

en.t: The Emperor looked at the illustrated album of The Song of Everlasting Sorrow and felt that although Yang Guifei's beauty in the painting came from the hand of a famous artist, the brushwork was limited and in the end lacked living spirit.

units.source_text: 诗中说贵妃的面庞和眉毛似“太液芙蓉未央柳”[\[18\]](#part1330.html#m18)，

en.t: The poem says that the noble consort's face and eyebrows were like the lotus of Taiye Pond and the willows of Weiyang Palace[\[18\]](#part1330.html#m18),

units.source_text: 固然比得确当，唐朝的装束也固然端丽优雅，但是，一回想桐壶更衣的妩媚温柔之姿，便觉得任何花鸟的颜色与声音都比不上了。

en.t: and the comparison was certainly apt, and the Tang dynasty attire was certainly dignified and elegant, but whenever he recalled the charming and gentle figure of the Kiritsubo Intimate, he felt that no flower's color or bird's song could compare with her.

units.source_text: 以前晨夕相处，惯说“在天愿作比翼鸟，在地愿为连理枝”之句[\[19\]](#part1330.html#m19)，共交盟誓。

en.t: In the past they had spent morning and evening together, often saying the lines, In heaven let us be birds flying wing to wing; on earth let us be branches joined as one[\[19\]](#part1330.html#m19), and had pledged their vows to each other.

units.source_text: 如今都变成了空花泡影。

en.t: Now all of it had become empty blossoms and vanishing bubbles.
Such was Heaven's decree, and his grief and resentment were endless!

units.source_text: 此时皇上听到风啸虫鸣，觉得无不催人哀思。

en.t: At this time, when the Emperor heard the wind whistling and the insects crying, he felt that every sound stirred sorrow in the heart.

units.source_text: 而弘徽殿女御久不参谒帝居，偏偏在这深夜时分玩赏月色，奏起丝竹管弦来。

en.t: Meanwhile, the Kokiden Consort, who had long neglected to visit the imperial residence, chose this deep hour of night to admire the moonlight and begin playing music on strings, flutes, and pipes.

units.source_text: 皇上听了，大为不快，觉得刺耳难闻。

en.t: When the Emperor heard it, he was greatly displeased and found the sound harsh and unpleasant.

units.source_text: 目睹皇上近日悲戚之状的[\[20\]](#part1330.html#m20)和女官们，听到这奏乐之声，也都从旁代抱不平。

en.t: Those who had seen the Emperor's sorrowful state in recent days[\[20\]](#part1330.html#m20), together with the court ladies, heard this music and also felt indignant on his behalf.

units.source_text: 这弘徽殿女御原是个非常顽强冷酷之人，全不把皇上之事放在心上，所以故作此举。

en.t: This Kokiden Consort was by nature an extremely stubborn and cold-hearted person; she gave no thought at all to the Emperor's feelings, and so she deliberately behaved in this way.
The moonlight sank toward the west.
Moved by the scene before him, the Emperor composed these lines aloud:
